examples.chinese: A：這種蛋糕很貴嗎？ B：是啊，這種蛋糕不便宜。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè zhǒng dàngāo hěn guì ma? B: Shì ā, zhè zhǒng dàngāo bù piányí.
examples.english: A: Is this kind of cake expensive? B: Yes, this kind of cake is not cheap.

examples.chinese: 這枝筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive, you had better buy a cheaper one.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子不大，可是很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn guì.
examples.english: This is not a big house, but very expensive.

examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

items.wordHook: At the 中(central) point, a 一(one) 貝(sea shell) rests → a 貴(expensive) price.

examples.chinese: 在你家，誰做家事？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ jiā, shéi zuò jiāshì?
examples.english: In your family, who does the housework?

examples.chinese: 暑假的時候，我跟弟弟一起做家事。我掃地，他洗碗筷。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià de shíhou, wǒ gēn dìdi yīqǐ zuò jiāshì. Wǒ sǎo dì, tā xǐ wǎnkuài.
examples.english: During summer vacation, I do housework together with my younger brother. I sweep the floor, and he washes the dishes.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我父母這個週末都不在家，家裡只剩下我一個人。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"我已經把衣服洗完了，剩下的家事請你做。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ zhège zhōumò dōu bù zài jiā, jiālǐ zhǐ shèngxià wǒ yī ge rén. Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yīfu xǐ wán le, shèngxià de jiāshì qǐng nǐ zuò.
examples.english: My parents are both not at home this weekend; only I am left at home. I have already finished washing the clothes; please do the remaining housework.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóbo duì zuò jiāshì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔyi, yīncǐ fùjìn de línjū cháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Uncle Li has many clever ideas for doing housework, so neighbors nearby often ask him for advice.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 對，我應該多注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: You are right. I should pay more attention to it.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

items.wordHook: 應(ought to) + 該(ought to) → 'ought to ought to': 應該 means should.

examples.chinese: 房東給了我鑰匙，明天就可以搬進去了。
examples.pinyin: Fángdōng gěi le wǒ yàoshi, míngtiān jiù kěyǐ bān jìnqù le.
examples.english: The landlord gave me the key, so I can move in tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 大家都出去了，還好我帶了鑰匙。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu chūqù le, hái hǎo wǒ dài le yàoshi.
examples.english: Everyone has gone out; luckily I brought my keys.

examples.chinese: 我沒有帶大門的鑰匙，不得不攀牆進去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dài dàmén de yàoshi, bùdébù pān qiáng jìnqù.
examples.english: I didn't bring the key to the main door, so I had no choice but to climb over the wall to get in.

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: Does this restaurant sell beverage?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的甜點很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant has delicious desserts.

examples.chinese: 你想去哪家餐廳？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā cāntīng?
examples.english: Which restaurant do you like to go to?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

items.wordHook: a 歺(dining board) is set, and 又(again) a hand reaches for the 食(food) → one 餐(meal).

examples.chinese: 他上課的時候很認真，所以功課一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngkè de shíhou hěn rènzhēn, suǒyǐ gōngkè yīzhí hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He is very conscientious in class, so his schoolwork has always been good.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 就我對小林的了解，他是一個很實在的人，不但做事認真，說話也不誇張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù wǒ duì Xiǎo Lín de liǎojiě, tā shì yīgè hěn shízài de rén, bùdàn zuòshì rènzhēn, shuōhuà yě bù kuāzhāng.
examples.english: With regard to my understanding of Xiao Lin, he is a very honest person; not only does he work seriously, but he also doesn't exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩年紀太小，不會自己穿衣服、脫褲子。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái niánjì tài xiǎo, bù huì zìjǐ chuān yīfu, tuō kùzi.
examples.english: That child is too young; he can't put on clothes or take off his pants by himself.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
examples.pinyin: Guójì bàngqiú bǐsài kuài kāishǐ le, nà yì qún gāng jìnrù bàngqiúchǎng, chuān lánsè yùndòngfú de jiùshì Táiwān duì.
examples.english: The international baseball game is about to start; that group that just entered the baseball field wearing blue sportswear is the Taiwan team.

examples.chinese: 他去過德國留學，難怪會說德文。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù guò Déguó liúxué, nánguài huì shuō Dévén.
examples.english: He has studied abroad in Germany; no wonder he can speak German.

examples.chinese: 弟弟昨天夜裡兩點才睡覺，難怪早上起不來。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān yèlǐ liǎng diǎn cái shuìjiào, nánguài zǎoshang qǐ bù lái.
examples.english: My younger brother didn't go to sleep until two o'clock last night; no wonder he couldn't get up in the morning.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
examples.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

examples.chinese: 張小姐的個性活潑大方，難怪有很多朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě de gèxìng huópō dàfāng, nánguài yǒu hěn duō péngyou.
examples.english: Miss Zhang's personality is lively and generous; no wonder she has many friends.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu shǒujī de shìyàng hěn jiējìn, nánguài wǒmen chángcháng ná cuò.
examples.english: My friend's and my cell phones are very similar in style; no wonder we often take the wrong one.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
examples.pinyin: Huālián Tàilǔgé dequè hěn piàoliang, nánguài měinián dōu xīyǐn xǔduō guānguāngkè qù cānguān.
examples.english: Hualien's Taroko Gorge is indeed very beautiful; no wonder it attracts many tourists to visit every year.

examples.chinese: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànzǐ gōngchǎng shàngbān, nánguài chāi jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn.
examples.english: She works at an electronics factory, no wonder her skill in disassembling machines is very proficient.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 「教師節」這個節日是為了紀念偉大的孔子。
examples.pinyin: 「Jiàoshī Jié」 zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn wěidà de Kǒngzǐ.
examples.english: The holiday "Teachers' Day" is for commemorating the great Confucius.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánxíng guǎngchǎng shì wèile jìniàn zìyóu ér jiàn de.
examples.english: This circular plaza was built to commemorate freedom.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bu néng gǎitiān zài shuō?
examples.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

examples.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bu néng gǎitiān zài shuō?
examples.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

examples.chinese: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xiǎng zuò de shì, nándào nǐ méiyǒu mèngxiǎng ma? B: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎndān guò shēnghuó, zàishuō, méiyǒu mèngxiǎng nándào bùxíng ma?
examples.english: A: You say you have nothing you want to do—don't you have dreams? B: I just want to live a simple life; besides, is it not okay to have no dreams?

examples.chinese: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.
examples.english: For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends.

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

examples.chinese: 登山的時候得注意安全，事前多準備，才能享受登山的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Dēngshān de shíhou děi zhùyì ānquán, shìqián duō zhǔnbèi, cái néng xiǎngshòu dēngshān de lèqù.
examples.english: When climbing a mountain, you must pay attention to safety; prepare more beforehand so you can enjoy the fun of mountain climbing.

examples.chinese: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí gǎibiàn yuánlái lǚxíng de ānpái, kěnéng huì dàilái bùtóng de lèqù.
examples.english: Sometimes changing the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

items.wordHook: Combining 樂(music) and 趣(interest): 樂趣 means pleasure, enjoyment, joy.
Combining 外(out) and 公(public): 外公 means grandfather mother's side.

examples.chinese: 公司很重視員工的身心健康，每年都安排一連五天的環島旅行，家人也可以參加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hěn zhòngshì yuángōng de shēnxīn jiànkāng, měi nián dōu ānpái yīlián wǔ tiān de huándǎo lǚxíng, jiārén yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
examples.english: The company places great importance on the physical and mental health of its employees, and every year arranges a five-day island tour, which family members can also join.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

items.wordHook: Combining 身(body) and 心(heart): 身心 means body and mind.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

items.wordHook: Combining 商(commerce) and 業(business): 商業 means commerce, business.

examples.chinese: 林老師是我的高中導師，在學習上也是影響我最深的人。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shì wǒ de gāozhōng dǎoshī, zài xuéxí shàng yěshì yǐngxiǎng wǒ zuì shēn de rén.
examples.english: Teacher Lin was my high school homeroom teacher and is also the person who has influenced me most in my studies.

examples.chinese: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ gāozhōng tóngxué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le, xiǎng zhǎo ge shìdàng shíjiān yāoqǐng dàjiā jù ju.
examples.english: I haven't seen my high school classmates for over ten years; I want to find an appropriate time to invite everyone to get together.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

items.wordHook: Combining 高(tall) and 中(middle): 高中 means senior high school.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: 不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Bùlùn shì gōngyè huò jiātíng fèishuǐ, duì rénmen de jiànkāng dōu yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Whether industrial or household waste water, it all has a bad impact on people's health.

examples.chinese: 他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí rè'ài fānyì gōngzuò, bùlùn duō kùnnan dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ kèfú.
examples.english: He has always been passionate about translation work; no matter how difficult it is, he will find a way to overcome it.

examples.chinese: 阿溫對花草很有興趣，不論生長在平原或山地的，他都叫得出名字來。
examples.pinyin: Ā Wēn duì huācǎo hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùlùn shēngzhǎng zài píngyuán huò shāndì de, tā dōu jiàodechū míngzi lái.
examples.english: A-Wen is very interested in flowers and plants; no matter whether they grow on plains or in mountains, he can name them all.

examples.chinese: 喜劇中的男女主角，不論相處過程中碰到多少挫折，結局總是快樂又幸福的。
examples.pinyin: Xǐjù zhōng de nánnǚ zhǔjiǎo, búlùn xiāngchǔ guòchéng zhōng pèngdào duōshǎo cuòzhé, jiéjú zǒngshì kuàilè yòu xìngfú de.
examples.english: In comedies, no matter how many setbacks the male and female leads encounter during their time together, the ending is always happy and blissful.

examples.chinese: 父母要求孩子不論在任何情況都不許騙人。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yāoqiú háizi bùlùn zài rènhé qíngkuàng dōu bùxǔ piàn rén.
examples.english: Parents require that their children must not lie under any circumstances.

examples.chinese: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu shì xìn Jīdūjiào de, bùlùn jiàohuì jǔbàn shénme huódòng, wǒmen dōu yīdìng qù cānjiā.
examples.english: Our whole family is Christian; no matter what activities the church holds, we always go to participate.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 如果從事某項工作能令你忘掉時間，或許就可當作一生的事業。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ cóngshì mǒu xiàng gōngzuò néng lìng nǐ wàngdiào shíjiān, huòxǔ jiù kě dàngzuò yīshēng de shìyè.
examples.english: If being engaged in a certain job can make you forget time, perhaps it can be treated as a lifelong career.

examples.chinese: 為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gèrén shìyè ér fàngxià xuéyè, duōshù rén shì hěn nán zuòdào de.
examples.english: To give up one's studies in order to develop a personal career is something most people find very hard to do.

examples.chinese: 聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi xīnláng zài shìyè shàng hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kuàngqiě yōudiǎn yě bù shǎo, gēn tā jiéhūn de nǚrén yīnggāi hěn xìngfú.
examples.english: I heard that bridegroom has great achievements in his career, and moreover has many good qualities; the woman who marries him should be very happy.

examples.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
examples.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 由於網路發達，現代人大都習慣上網購物。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú wǎnglù fādá, xiàndài rén dàdōu xíguàn shàngwǎng gòuwù.
examples.english: Due to the development of the Internet, modern people for the most part are accustomed to shopping online.

examples.chinese: 我去醫院看完病後，醫生給了我一張單子去櫃檯付錢和領藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn wán bìng hòu, yīshēng gěi le wǒ yī zhāng dānzi qù guìtái fù qián hé lǐng yào.
examples.english: After I finished seeing the doctor at the hospital, the doctor gave me a form to go to the counter to pay and pick up medicine.

examples.chinese: 國外商品來到本國後，賣出的價錢往往比國外高出一兩成。
examples.pinyin: Guówài shāngpǐn lái dào běnguó hòu, mài chū de jiàqián wǎngwǎng bǐ guówài gāo chū yī liǎng chéng.
examples.english: After foreign goods arrive in this country, the selling price is often one or two tenths higher than abroad.

examples.chinese: 他把這塊長方形蛋糕分成兩塊三角形的。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè kuài chángfāngxíng dàngāo fēn chéng liǎng kuài sānjiǎoxíng de.
examples.english: He divided this rectangular cake into two triangular pieces.

examples.chinese: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xīnshēng bìxū zài kāixué qián yī zhōu wánchéng zhùcè shǒuxù.
examples.english: The school stipulates that new students must complete the registration procedures one week before the semester starts.

examples.chinese: 如果你是那家網路商店的會員，購買任何商品都可以便宜兩成。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ shì nà jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de huìyuán, gòumǎi rènhé shāngpǐn dōu kěyǐ piányi liǎng chéng.
examples.english: If you are a member of that online store, you can buy any product for twenty percent cheaper.

examples.chinese: 做生意前得先算一下成本，划算才去做。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì qián děi xiān suàn yíxià chéngběn, huásuàn cái qù zuò.
examples.english: Before doing business, you must first calculate the costs; only do it if it's worth it.

examples.chinese: 顧客付了錢，賣家也交了貨，這樣子交易才算完成。
examples.pinyin: Gùkè fù le qián, màijiā yě jiāo le huò, zhèyàngzi jiāoyì cái suàn wánchéng.
examples.english: The customer has paid, and the seller has delivered the goods; only then is the transaction considered complete.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

examples.chinese: 現在的手機都具有語音轉成文字的功能，用來記錄事情非常便利。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de shǒujī dōu jùyǒu yǔyīn zhuǎn chéng wénzì de gōngnéng, yòng lái jìlù shìqíng fēicháng biànlì.
examples.english: Today's mobile phones all have the function of converting voice into text, which is very convenient for recording things.

examples.chinese: 一個人做錯事多半是自己造成的，不能一做錯就怪別人。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén zuòcuò shì duōbàn shì zìjǐ zàochéng de, bùnéng yī zuòcuò jiù guài biérén.
examples.english: When a person does something wrong, it is mostly caused by themselves; you can't just blame others as soon as you make a mistake.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
examples.pinyin: Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.
examples.english: Population increase not only affects the quality of life, but恐怕 also causes the problem of food shortage.

examples.chinese: 這個世界拼圖很難拼，得花好幾天才拼得成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shìjiè pīntú hěn nán pīn, děi huā hǎo jǐ tiān cái pīn de chéng.
examples.english: This world puzzle is very difficult to piece together; it will take several days to piece it together successfully.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.
examples.english: Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cún le bànbèizi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēngyì, jiéguǒ shēngyì bù chénggōng, qián dōu méi le.
examples.english: He took all the money he had saved for half his life to do business, but the business was unsuccessful, and all the money was gone.

examples.chinese: 這本小說是以愛情的題材寫成的，後來被拍成了一部浪漫的電影。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō shì yǐ àiqíng de tícái xiě chéng de, hòulái bèi pāi chéng le yī bù làngmàn de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This novel is written with a love theme, and was later made into a romantic movie.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà, bùshǎo lǎo fángwū yǐjīng biànchéng xīn dàlóu le.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我過得很充實，不但完成了期末報告，還跟同學去游泳、衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí, búdàn wánchéng le qīmò bàogào, hái gēn tóngxué qù yóuyǒng, chōnglàng.
examples.english: This weekend I had a very full time—not only did I finish my final report, but I also went swimming and surfing with classmates.

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 今天中文口試時我太緊張了，一時不知道怎麼回答，所以成績不太好。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Zhōngwén kǒushì shí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yīshí bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, suǒyǐ chéngjī bù tài hǎo.
examples.english: During the Chinese oral exam today, I was too nervous and for a moment didn't know how to answer, so my grade wasn't very good.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 他吹笛子吹得很好，辦過幾場很成功的音樂表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuī dízi chuī de hěn hǎo, bànguò jǐ chǎng hěn chénggōng de yīnyuè biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: He plays the flute very well and has held several very successful music performances.

examples.chinese: 我們的成長經驗、教育背景都差不多，所以想法也很像。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de chéngzhǎng jīngyàn, jiàoyù bèijǐng dōu chàbuduō, suǒyǐ xiǎngfǎ yě hěn xiàng.
examples.english: Our upbringing experiences and educational backgrounds are about the same, so our ideas are also very similar.

examples.chinese: 用不同的方法教育不同的學生，這樣才是成功的教育方式。
examples.pinyin: Yòng bùtóng de fāngfǎ jiàoyù bùtóng de xuéshēng, zhèyàng cái shì chénggōng de jiàoyù fāngshì.
examples.english: Educating different students with different methods—this is the successful way of education.

examples.chinese: 我這次考試的成績不太好，下次我會更加努力的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè cì kǎoshì de chéngjì bú tài hǎo, xià cì wǒ huì gèngjiā nǔlì de.
examples.english: My grades on this exam are not very good; next time I will work even more hard.

examples.chinese: 等我完成期末報告，就要跟同學去韓國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ wánchéng qīmò bàogào, jiù yào gēn tóngxué qù Hánguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: After I finish my final report, I will go traveling to Korea with my classmates.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣極重視考試的成績，可是她覺得參加社團也會有很多收穫。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn jí zhòngshì kǎoshì de chéngjì, kěshì tā juéde cānjiā shètuán yě huì yǒu hěn duō shōuhuò.
examples.english: Chen Kexin highly values exam grades, but she feels that joining clubs will also bring many rewards.

examples.chinese: 以前沒什麼人喜歡露營，可是最近露營變成了一種流行的活動。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián méi shénme rén xǐhuān lùyíng, kěshì zuìjìn lùyíng biànchéngle yī zhǒng liúxíng de huódòng.
examples.english: Before, not many people liked camping, but recently camping has become a popular activity.

examples.chinese: 他的成績很好，有機會得到出國留學的獎學金。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì hěn hǎo, yǒu jīhuì dédào chūguó liúxué de jiǎngxuéjīn.
examples.english: His grades are very good; he has a chance to get a scholarship to study abroad.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"到東部的火車票很難訂，我訂了好幾次才成功。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次社區的中秋節活動辦得很成功，大家都玩得很開心。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Dào dōngbù de huǒchēpiào hěn nán dìng, wǒ dìng le hǎojǐ cì cái chénggōng. Zhè cì shèqū de zhōngqiūjié huódòng bàn de hěn chénggōng, dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Tickets for trains to the east are hard to book; I tried several times before succeeding. This time the community's Mid-Autumn Festival event was very successful, and everyone had a great time.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"老師很滿意大家這次期中考的成績。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次期中考，大家都考得很好，老師覺得很滿意。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
examples.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

examples.chinese: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng shípǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuòfǎ, bùdàn báibái làngfèi shíwù, huíshōu chǔlǐ de chéngběn yě zēngjiā le, chángqī xiàlái shífēn làngfèi.
examples.english: This convenience store's practice of throwing away food that isn't sold out not only wastes food for nothing, but the cost of recycling processing also increases; over the long term, it is extremely wasteful.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ biàn huáng de shūcài yèzi mái zài dì lǐ, ràng tā biànchéng cǎodì de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Grandma buried the yellowed vegetable leaves in the ground, letting them become nutrition for the lawn.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 他以前化學成績常不及格，沒想到現在卻是有名的化學教授。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐqián huàxué chéngjī cháng bù jígé, méi xiǎngdào xiànzài què shì yǒumíng de huàxué jiàoshòu.
examples.english: He used to often fail chemistry, but unexpectedly now he is a famous chemistry professor.

examples.chinese: 我把房間裡那條黑色繩子看成蛇，嚇了我一大跳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ fángjiān lǐ nà tiáo hēisè shéngzi kàn chéng shé, xià le wǒ yī dà tiào.
examples.english: I mistook that black rope in the room for a snake and got a big scare.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
examples.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

examples.chinese: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào Zhōu bóshì duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ shí, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When they heard that Dr. Zhou's years of research had finally produced results, all the employees gave him the biggest applause.

examples.chinese: 人類大腦分成幾區，有的管語言，有的管記憶，很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi dànǎo fēnchéng jǐ qū, yǒude guǎn yǔyán, yǒude guǎn jìyì, hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: The human brain is divided into several areas; some manage language, some manage memory—it's very interesting.

examples.chinese: 錢先生買了一只上百萬的鑽石戒指，當成跟女友求婚的禮物。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng mǎi le yì zhī shàng bǎi wàn de zuànshí jièzhǐ, dāngchéng gēn nǚyǒu qiúhūn de lǐwù.
examples.english: Mr. Qian bought a diamond ring worth over a million, considering it a gift to propose to his girlfriend.

examples.chinese: 公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī shàngtóu yāoqiú Xiǎo Zhāng yī gè rén wánchéng rènwu, tóngshìmen dōu rènwéi yǒudiǎnr miǎnqiǎng.
examples.english: The company higher-ups asked Xiao Zhang to complete the task alone; his colleagues all thought it was a bit of a stretch.

examples.chinese: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn dàxué kēxì duì xuéshēng chéngjì de yāoqiú fēicháng gāo, bìyè tiáojiàn yě jiào yángé.
examples.english: Some university departments have very high requirements for student grades, and graduation conditions are also stricter.

examples.chinese: 我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le xǔduō bànfǎ qù dáchéng gōngsī de mùbiāo, què háishì dé bú dào zhǔguǎn de zhīchí.
examples.english: I thought of many ways to achieve the company's goal, but still couldn't get the supervisor's support.

examples.chinese: 好的開始是成功的一半，第一步往往最重要。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo de kāishǐ shì chénggōng de yíbàn, dì yī bù wǎngwǎng zuì zhòngyào.
examples.english: A good beginning is half of success; the first step is often the most important.

examples.chinese: 當父母的總是希望子女將來能有成就，過著幸福的日子。
examples.pinyin: Dāng fùmǔ de zǒngshì xīwàng zǐnǚ jiānglái néng yǒu chéngjiù, guòzhe xìngfú de rìzi.
examples.english: Parents always hope their children will have achievements in the future and live happy days.

examples.chinese: 要想成為成功的上班族，一切就得照規矩來。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chéngwéi chénggōng de shàngbānzú, yīqiè jiù děi zhào guīju lái.
examples.english: If you want to become a successful office worker, everything must be done according to the rules.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

examples.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
examples.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
examples.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

examples.chinese: 軍人接到任務時，不管多麼危險都得努力完成。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén jiēdào rènwu shí, bùguǎn duōme wēixiǎn dōu děi nǔlì wánchéng.
examples.english: When soldiers receive a mission, no matter how dangerous it is, they must strive to complete it.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi xīnláng zài shìyè shàng hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kuàngqiě yōudiǎn yě bù shǎo, gēn tā jiéhūn de nǚrén yīnggāi hěn xìngfú.
examples.english: I heard that bridegroom has great achievements in his career, and moreover has many good qualities; the woman who marries him should be very happy.

examples.chinese: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ māma bǎ bǎobǎo měi tiān de shēnghuó dōu jìlù xiàlái, xiěchéng yī piān piān de rìjì.
examples.english: Mrs. Li recorded the baby's daily life, writing it into diary entries one after another.

examples.chinese: 這個角色一直找不到合適的演員，幸好那位明星點頭答應演出，否則影片就拍不成了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juésè yīzhí zhǎo bù dào héshì de yǎnyuán, xìngkuī nà wèi míngxīng diǎntóu dāyìng yǎnchū, fǒuzé yǐngpiàn jiù pāi bù chéng le.
examples.english: They couldn't find a suitable actor for this role all along; fortunately, that celebrity nodded and agreed to perform, otherwise the film couldn't have been made.

examples.chinese: 鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
examples.pinyin: É yī kàndào mòshēngrén jiù huì dàjiào, suǒyǐ xiāngcūn lǐ yǒu rén bǎ é dāngchéng gǒu lái kānjiā.
examples.english: As soon as a goose sees a stranger, it will honk loudly, so in the countryside some people treat geese like dogs to guard the house.

examples.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
examples.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

examples.chinese: 故事中的女主角吻了白馬一下，白馬就變成了英俊的國王。
examples.pinyin: Gùshì zhōng de nǚzhǔjiǎo wěn le báimǎ yīxià, báimǎ jiù biànchéng le yīngjùn de guówáng.
examples.english: The female protagonist in the story kissed the white horse once, and the white horse turned into a handsome king.

examples.chinese: 公司如果關心客戶並達成他們的需求，對業務或多或少有好處。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī rúguǒ guānxīn kèhù bìng dáchéng tāmen de xūqiú, duì yèwù huòduōhuòshǎo yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: If a company cares about its customers and meets their needs, it is more or less beneficial to the business.

examples.chinese: 有些學校將教育當成商品來買賣，但也有人不支持。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuéxiào jiāng jiàoyù dàngchéng shāngpǐn lái mǎimài, dàn yě yǒu rén bù zhīchí.
examples.english: Some schools treat education as a commodity to buy and sell, but there are also people who do not support this.

examples.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
examples.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

examples.chinese: 人的性格主要是受成長環境的影響，跟性別沒有太大的關係。
examples.pinyin: Rén de xìnggé zhǔyào shì shòu chéngzhǎng huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng, gēn xìngbié méiyǒu tài dà de guānxi.
examples.english: A person's personality is mainly influenced by their growing environment, and has little to do with gender.

examples.chinese: 她沒有針對此事發表看法，所以不知道她贊不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhēnduì cǐ shì fābiǎo kànfǎ, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào tā zàn bù zànchéng.
examples.english: She didn't express her views on this matter, so we don't know whether she approves or not.

examples.chinese: 這家造船公司製造的船因成本高，價錢稍微貴了一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zàochuán gōngsī zhìzào de chuán yīn chéngběn gāo, jiàqián shāowēi guì le yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: The ships manufactured by this shipbuilding company are slightly more expensive because of high costs.

examples.chinese: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shàng, měi cì gémìng dōu duì shèhuì zàochéng fēicháng dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In history, every revolution has had a very great impact on society.

examples.chinese: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
examples.pinyin: Huàzhuāng wǔhuì shàng tā dǎbàn chéng yī jù jīqìrén, lián shuōhuà zǒulù dōu mófǎng jīqìrén.
examples.english: At the masquerade ball, he dressed up as a robot, even imitating a robot when speaking and walking.

examples.chinese: 父母反對她從事電影行業，哪怕收入很高，還是不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ fǎnduì tā cóngshì diànyǐng hángyè, nǎpà shōurù hěn gāo, háishì bù zànchéng.
examples.english: Her parents oppose her working in the film industry; even if the income is high, they still do not approve.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

examples.chinese: 這塊玉的品質不錯，如果做成玉器應該可以賣出好價錢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài yù de pǐnzhì bùcuò, rúguǒ zuòchéng yùqì yīnggāi kěyǐ mài chū hǎo jiàqián.
examples.english: The quality of this piece of jade is quite good; if it is made into jade ware, it should be able to sell for a good price.

examples.chinese: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn, kèfú kùnnán de rén, cái néng shēnshēn tǐhuì dào chéngjiùgǎn dàilái de kuàilè.
examples.english: Only those who bravely face challenges and overcome difficulties can deeply experience the happiness that a sense of accomplishment brings.

examples.chinese: 康小姐的工作能力很強，能一面掌握會議的重點，一面把會議內容翻譯成外文。
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, néng yīmiàn zhǎngwò huìyì de zhòngdiǎn, yīmiàn bǎ huìyì nèiróng fānyì chéng wàiwén.
examples.english: Miss Kang's work ability is very strong; she can simultaneously grasp the key points of a meeting and translate the meeting content into a foreign language.

examples.chinese: 這家公司成立不到兩年，現在的規模已發展得十分完整。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chénglì bù dào liǎng nián, xiànzài de guīmó yǐ fāzhǎn de shífēn wánzhěng.
examples.english: This company was established less than two years ago, and its current scale has already developed quite completely.

examples.chinese: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Sūn xiǎojiě zuìjìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēngyì, biǎoxiàn chūsè, yúshì gōngsī juédìng tígāo tā de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: Miss Sun recently closed several big deals and her performance was outstanding, so the company decided to raise her salary.

examples.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

examples.chinese: 人人都崇拜明星，但有多少人了解成功背後所付出的一切？
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu chóngbài míngxīng, dàn yǒu duōshǎo rén liǎojiě chénggōng bèihòu suǒ fùchū de yíqiè?
examples.english: Everyone adores stars, but how many people understand all that is sacrificed behind success?

examples.chinese: 別怕失敗，因為失敗的經驗比成功更珍貴。
examples.pinyin: Bié pà shībài, yīnwèi shībài de jīngyàn bǐ chénggōng gèng zhēnguì.
examples.english: Don't be afraid of failure, because the experience of failure is more precious than success.

examples.chinese: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shì yóu dàhuì chéngyuán yīqǐ tǎolùn hòu juédìng de, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
examples.english: This regulation was decided after discussion by the assembly members together, and must be strictly followed.

items.wordHook: a 戊(halberd) shape takes a hook inside and plants firmly → the task will 成(accomplish).

examples.chinese: 今天百貨公司有優惠活動，買一條床單就送一床被子(quilt)。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bǎihuò gōngsī yǒu yōuhuì huódòng, mǎi yī tiáo chuángdān jiù sòng yī chuáng bèizi.
examples.english: Today the department store has a special promotion: buy one bed sheet and get one quilt free.

examples.chinese: 他把朋友送他的畫先捲起來，等有空時再找地方掛上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ péngyou sòng tā de huà xiān juǎn qǐlái, děng yǒu kòng shí zài zhǎo dìfang guà shàng.
examples.english: He first rolled up the painting his friend gave him, and when he has time he'll find a place to hang it.

examples.chinese: 家裡的衛生紙快用完了，下班回家時順便買幾卷吧。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ de wèishēngzhǐ kuài yòng wán le, xiàbān huí jiā shí shùnbiàn mǎi jǐ juǎn ba.
examples.english: The toilet paper at home is almost used up; on your way home from work, buy a few rolls while you're at it.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ kǎojuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī hòu, lǎoshī jiù bǎ zhèngquè de dá'àn gàosu dàjiā.
examples.english: After we handed the exam papers to the teacher, the teacher then told everyone the correct answers.

items.wordHook: Tied grain stalks 龹(grain sheaf) beside a kneeling 卩(seal) scribe are rolled into a parchment 卷(book).
上(on) + 網(net): you go "on" the "net" → to use the internet.
上(on) + 課(lesson): you go onto a lesson → attend class.
a 亻(person) 也(also) waves from the doorway → 他(he).
A captive's torn 耳(ear) is seized firmly in a victor's 又(hand) as spoils to claim and 取(take).
Combining 氣(air) and 溫(warm): 氣溫 means temperature.
水果 means fruit. 水(water) + 果(fruit) → fruits are watery.
Combining 災(disaster) and 情(feeling): 災情 means damage due to a disaster.
Having 無(no) doubt what 論(debate) arises or 如(if) 何(what) happens: 無論如何 means in any case.
Combining 球(ball) and 鞋(shoes): 球鞋 means sneakers.
A diner eats a ⺼(meat) plate 半(half) full each day → soon he is 胖(fat).
Structuring your spoken 言(speech) into orderly 侖(logical) arguments fuels an engaging public 論(debate).
這(this) + 裡(inside) → this inside spot: 這裡(here).
